text:
Asha: Quick sync — SIEM mapping + customer-facing audit names. Need a decision on: (1) stable machine-id for integrations, (2) human-friendly label for UI/docs, (3) mapping to ECS fields, (4) versioning strategy. Ok if we split machine vs human names?

Tom: +1 to splitting. Machine IDs = dot.sep (`auth.user.login.success`) is easy to parse. Human label = full sentence like 'User logged in (success)'.

Priya: Agree on split. Also: put verb in `event.action` and grouping in `event.category` per ECS. Machine ids should be consistent present-tense verbs (eg `login.success`).

Lena-ui: For customer-facing UIs we should never show dots. Show readable phrase + outcome badge. I'll mock some examples. @lena-ui

Samir: From SIEM side: please include `event.outcome` with canonical values (`success` / `failure`) and a `failure_reason` free text. Also `actor.principal_type` (user/service) for RBAC audits.

Asha: Draft schema example (for discussion):
```json
{
  "event.name": "auth.user.login.success",
  "event.action": "login",
  "event.category": "authentication",
  "event.outcome": "success",
  "actor.id": "u_12345",
  "actor.type": "user",
  "resource.type": "session",
  "resource.id": "s_67890",
  "version": "audit-v2"
}
```

Tom: For customer-facing logs expose `event.label`: "User logged in (success)" and keep `event.name` as stable internal key. Docs show mapping to ECS fields and examples for SIEM parsers.

Priya: Minor: avoid tense mismatch in labels. Machine: `login.success`. Label: `User logged in (success)`. Keep verb form consistent.

Lena-ui: I'll produce 3 UI mockups: dashboard table, single event modal, and export CSV examples. Will post in #design later today.

Asha: Action items: 1) finalize naming convention (asha) 2) PR schema changes + examples (priya) 3) customer docs + UI mocks (lena-ui) 4) SIEM/ECS mapping sample (samir). Everyone ok with assignments? :white_check_mark:

Tom: ACK

Samir: will draft ECS mapping (Elastic/Datadog friendly) by EOD tomorrow.

Priya: I'll open the schema PR with the snippet above + tests.

audit-bot: Draft published: https://redwood.internal/docs/audit-schema/v2 — comment window 72h.

audit-bot: Reminder: audit schema deploy to staging scheduled at 1990016000

Asha: Thanks all, will consolidate decisions and update the spec doc after PR lands.
